notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ nɔnabila 3 dɔ fara יקום kan, Heburukan ma min sɔrɔ

notes.subject: גואלי
notes.rationale: gɔlilitigi (balimaya ka gɔlili daɲɛ) wa 'min bɛ ne ban'? sɛbɛnnikɛlaw bɛ a fɔ lajabi caman na

notes.subject: ואחרון
notes.rationale: 'kaban (mɔgɔ)' walima 'ne kɔfɛ (ne kaban na)' — taamasiyɛn dɔgɔlen don

notes.subject: kɔgɔdakunbila ɲɛfɔli
notes.rationale: kumasen in bɛ Aibu ka kɔgɔdakunbila ɲini — o ye sumaya dɔ don min ma jira a fɔlɔ

translation: Nka ne, ne dɔn ne ka gɔlilitigi ali ye, kaban kɔnɔ ⟨a⟩ bɛna jɔ buguri kan.
